questions.question: How did Aoi Todo come to be trained in jujutsu?
questions.subject: Aoi Todo/Synopsis

answer.item: When he was in grade school, he had met a sorcerer who asked what his type of woman was after he had just defeated a high school student. Aoi felt that this event would cure his boredom and went on to be trained by her in Jujutsu.

questions.question: What did Aoi accomplish on December 24, 2017?
questions.subject: Aoi Todo/Synopsis

answer.item: Years later on December 24, 2017, when Geto launched an attack at Shinjuku and Kyoto, Aoi had taken out 6 cursed spirits, 5 first-grade cursed spirits without using his cursed technique, and 1 special grade cursed spirit with his technique, all by himself.

questions.question: Why did Aoi attack Megumi when they first met?
questions.subject: Aoi Todo/Synopsis

answer.item: When Megumi gave Aoi an answer, Aoi called him boring and attacked him.

questions.question: What did Aoi tell Yuji about his cursed energy during their fight?
questions.subject: Aoi Todo/Synopsis

answer.item: Aoi also figured out that Yuji's cursed energy has a habit of lagging and says that is wrong. Aoi told Yuji that if he wants to get stronger then he will have to stop having his cursed energy lag, which Yuji agreed with.

questions.question: How did Aoi help Yuji keep landing Black Flash on Hanami?
questions.subject: Aoi Todo/Synopsis

answer.item: Aoi then used his technique to have Yuji continuously attack Hanami with Black Flash.

questions.question: Why couldn't Aoi accompany Yuji on his promotion missions?
questions.subject: Aoi Todo/Synopsis

answer.item: Mei Mei told him that the one that nominated the person is not able to accompany the nominee, much to Aoi's disappointment.

questions.question: How did Aoi save Yuji from Mahito in Shibuya?
questions.subject: Aoi Todo/Synopsis

answer.item: Just as Mahito was about to execute a distressed Yuji Itadori, Aoi appeared just in time to save him, using Boogie Woogie to swap positions with Mahito.

questions.question: How did Aoi help Yuta kill Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Aoi Todo/Synopsis

answer.item: Todo helped Yuta Okkotsu in his sneak attack against the sorcerer, swapping the two to allow Yuta to kill him.

questions.question: How did Aoi upgrade Boogie Woogie for the raid on Sukuna?
questions.subject: Aoi Todo/Synopsis

answer.item: Todo revealed he replaced his missing arm with a Vibraslap, and changed the conditions of Boogie Woogie from a clap to the hitting of the Vibraslap allowing him to now preform 50 position swaps per second.

questions.question: Why is Aoi's whereabouts unknown to Jujutsu Headquarters?
questions.subject: Aoi Todo/Synopsis

answer.item: His whereabouts remain unknown to Jujutsu Headquarters as he is on bad terms with every other sorcerer barring Yuji.
